question.problem:
What is the $x$-coordinate of the point $P?$

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/linear/14129504/assets/cf628679e0e9726a0db5d3399d992a0333911be16b8ccd89d2d6455e540ea3d9.png)
question.worked_solution:
To find the coordinates of $P,$ we start at the origin, move $3$ units *left*, and then $2$ units *up*. 

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/linear/14129504/assets/2df77be5e817368e4082061f623ab2c10f2ec7f2ebd042864a1418e0aa67592f.png)

The coordinates of $P$ are $({\color{red}{-3}},{\color{blue}{2}}).$ Therefore, the $x$-coordinate of $P$ is ${\color{red}{-3}}.$
